description: Get a public, no-login shareable link to a creator's CreatorScore profile — for sending to a colleague or dropping in a deck. Give it EITHER a handle (e.g. platform 'tiktok' + handle 'jane' — the easy way, just ask the user for their @username) OR an identity_group_id (from find_creator). The page shows their unified cross-platform footprint score. FREE — 0 credits, no scraping. The creator must already have a CreatorScore profile; if the handle isn't in our index yet, score them first with score_creator_footprint.

handle.description: The creator's @username (without @). The simplest input — pair with platform when known.

identity_group_id.description: The creator's identity_group_id (from find_creator). Alternative to handle.

platform.description: Platform for the handle (recommended when the same handle exists on several platforms).

name: get_shareable_link
